title: Anthony Hopkins finds Feifer's annotated copy of The Girl from Petrovka
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Anthony Hopkins finds Feifer's annotated copy of The Girl from Petrovka, about 1972 at Leicester Square tube station, London, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Heading for home, he chanced upon a book on a bench at the Lester Square tube station.

plain: A well-known skeptic and writer, Michael Shermer, retells a famous coincidence about the actor Anthony Hopkins and a novel called The Girl from Petrovka by the author George Feifer. As Shermer tells it, around 1972 Hopkins was heading home and happened upon a copy of the book on a bench at Leicester Square tube station in London, and it turned out to be Feifer's own copy with his notes in it. The story is told to show how strange coincidences can feel meaningful.
